summary: Flowco Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing that its wholly owned subsidiary, Lifting Solutions Holdings Canada Corp., entered into a Share Purchase Agreement on October 2, 2026, to acquire Lifting Solutions Energy Services Inc. from its shareholders and warrantholders for C$159.0 million in cash, plus a contingent earnout of up to C$10.0 million tied to 2027 EBITDA. The Edmonton, Alberta-based target manufactures artificial lift technologies, including continuous rod and progressing cavity pumps. Closing occurred simultaneously with signing; cash-free, debt-free structure funded via the company's five-year senior secured revolving credit facility. Earnout pays ratably between C$32.0 million and C$36.8 million EBITDA, payable by March 31, 2028. No advisor named, no premium stated, no regulatory clock disclosed. Watch for earnout achievement and leverage impact of revolver funding.
